coverage_summary.note: The two metro reports cover the same Phase 3 corridors; the aquifer report and KML each cover the full BBMP city area.

metro_package_overlap.conclusion: Treat as one package: extract the environmental baseline ONCE (prefer the EIA standalone), and take geotechnical/engineering evidence only from the engineering report. Do not double-count stations, samples, or DPR citations across the two files.
metro_package_overlap.differing_lengths: Engineering Table 1-2 states Corridor 3-1 as 32.15 km; EIA Table 1-2 states 32.2 km. Corridor 3-2 is 12.5 km in both. Minor rounding-level difference only.
metro_package_overlap.shared_authorship: Both authored by the same JICA Study Team (Oriental Consultants Global, Nippon Koei, JIC Transportation, Pacific Consultants).
metro_package_overlap.shared_baseline: Engineering ch.14 (Environmental and Social Considerations) embeds the same ESIA baseline as EIA ch.6-7.
metro_package_overlap.shared_legacy_data: Both cite the same BMRCL/RITES (2023) DPR legacy datasets (6 air, 6 soil, 8 water samples) and the same BMRCL/Monarch Jan-Apr 2025 dry-season surveys.
metro_package_overlap.unique_to_eia: Standalone EIA structure: full scoping/ToR (ch.6), management and monitoring plans (ch.10-12), stakeholder consultations with dated Sept 2025 meeting records (ch.13), grievance redress (ch.14).
metro_package_overlap.unique_to_engineering: Engineering content absent from the EIA: DPR geological survey of 36 boreholes with SPT/lab/foundation analysis (§5.3.1), topographic/utility surveys, demand forecast, alignment/station design, cost, TOD, O&M chapters.
metro_package_overlap.verbatim_duplication_verified: Engineering §14.7.1 Table 14-57 is identical to EIA §7.1.1 Table 7-1: same 27 air stations A1-A27 with identical coordinates (e.g. A1 Ranka Colony 12°54'24.57"N 77°36'4.26"E). TOR table text (§14.6 vs EIA ch.6) is likewise identical.
